pages.text: The Memory Card is used to copy-and paste settings between AE2 $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)devices$(/l), and link $(l:items_blocks_machines/p2p_tunnels)P2P tunnels$(/l). It can also paste $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrade cards$(/l) into devices.$(li)Shift-right-click to copy settings or generate a new P2P linking frequency.$(li)Right-click to paste the settings, upgrade cards, or linking frequency.
